# Oxford Home Study

> > Oxford Home Study offers accredited online distance learning courses across business, technology, creative, and professional fields with flexible 24/7 access and industry-recognized certifications.

Oxford Home Study is a comprehensive online learning platform providing professional development and skills training through distance education. The platform specializes in regulated, accredited courses spanning management, technology, creative industries, and specialized professional disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Online Learning
- Distance Education
- Professional Development
- Artificial Intelligence
- Project Management
- Business Studies
- Accounting & Finance
- Leadership & Soft Skills
- Construction Management
- Marketing & Communications
- Hospitality Management
- Supply Chain & Logistics
- Health & Safety
- Accredited Certifications
- Home Study Programs

## Business & Management

- [Business Studies Online](https://www.oxfordhomestudy.com/courses/business-studies-online): Business studies certificates and courses via distance learning
- [Project Management Courses Online](https://www.oxfordhomestudy.com/courses/project-management-courses-online): Project management distance learning with 24/7 access and certification
- [Online Management Courses](https://www.oxfordhomestudy.com/courses/online-management-courses): Online management courses covering leadership and organizational skills
- [Leadership and Soft Skills](https://www.oxfordhomestudy.com/courses/leadership-and-soft-skills): Leadership and soft skills training for professional development
- [Supply Chain Courses Online](https://www.oxfordhomestudy.com/courses/supply-chain-courses-online): Supply chain and logistics management courses with certifications
